CVE-2026-43870 covers path traversal, HTTP response splitting, origin validation, and resource consumption bugs in the Apache Thrift Node.js web_server.js sample server. Debian thrift 0.19.0-4 does not build or ship Node.js components.

CVE-2026-43869 is missing TLS hostname verification in Apache Thrift Java client transports (TSSLTransportFactory.java and TNonblockingSSLSocket.java). Debian thrift 0.19.0-4 builds with --without-java and does not ship Java libraries.
CVE-2026-43868 is excessive memory allocation in the Apache Thrift Rust implementation. Debian thrift 0.19.0-4 builds with --without-rust and does not ship Rust bindings.
CVE-2026-41636 is uncontrolled recursion in the Apache Thrift Node.js bindings. Debian thrift 0.19.0-4 ships C++, Python, PHP, Perl, and Go bindings but does not build or ship Node.js artifacts.

CVE-2026-41605 is an integer overflow in the Apache Thrift Swift Compact Protocol implementation. Debian thrift 0.19.0-4 ships C++, Python, PHP, Perl, and Go bindings but does not build or ship Swift language bindings.

CVE-2026-41604 is an out-of-bounds read in the Apache Thrift Swift bindings (Swift Range crash in skip()). Debian thrift 0.19.0-4 ships C++, Python, PHP, Perl, and Go bindings but does not build or ship Swift bindings. Debian security tracking marks the fix experimental with a note that Swift bindings are not built in the Debian package.
